verdict.rationale: A remote-desktop product with a management console holding session and device data could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers non-AI features: CLI automation, a REST API for session history, and basic system stats or CSV export. Nothing documents AI-generated insights or suggestions inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
